name: Flow · 1 Intake

options.system: You sort inbound business inquiries for a professional services firm. You return strict JSON only.

parameters.responseBody: { "ok": false, "error": "Please include a valid email address and a message of at least 10 characters." }
={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, ref: $("Build Inquiry Record").item.json.inquiry_ref }) }}

value.detail: ={{ $("Build Inquiry Record").item.json.ai_status }} · {{ $("Build Inquiry Record").item.json.topic }} · {{ $("Build Inquiry Record").item.json.urgency }}{{ $("Build Inquiry Record").item.json.is_spam ? " · spam" : "" }}

parameters.content:
## Benjaire Flow · Intake
POST JSON to /webhook/flow-intake with header **x-flow-key** (value in the flow_settings table).
Fields: name, email, company, phone, message, source, website (hidden honeypot, must be empty).

Claude sorts the inquiry; the record is saved; the owner gets an alert with a suggested reply and one click status buttons; the sender gets an acknowledgement. Spam is saved but not answered.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ from: $('Load Client Settings').first().json.from_address, to: [$json.owner_email], reply_to: $json.email, subject: $json.alert_subject, html: $json.alert_html }) }}

nodes.name: Alert Owner
nodes.notes: Sends the owner alert through Resend from the firm's own address.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ from: $('Load Client Settings').first().json.from_address, to: [$('Build Inquiry Record').item.json.email], reply_to: $('Load Client Settings').first().json.reply_to_email, subject: $('Build Inquiry Record').item.json.ack_subject, html: $('Build Inquiry Record').item.json.ack_html }) }}

nodes.name: Send Acknowledgement
nodes.notes: Acknowledges the prospect from contact@; replies route through Cloudflare to the owner inbox.

description: Benjaire Flow intake: receives website inquiries, checks the intake key, sorts them with Claude, saves them, alerts the owner with one click status buttons and acknowledges the sender.
